latestVersion.changelog:
html-to-one-pptx 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for pixel-faithful HTML to PowerPoint (.pptx) conversion.
- Supports both single and multiple HTML files (each as one slide, merged if multiple).
- Fully documented, stepwise workflow—never batch, always write/run each gen.js one at a time.
- Enforces thorough HTML parsing, chart detection, color auditing, and structured gen.js generation.
- Uses detailed markdown templates to ensure every visual/text/chart element is explicitly specified before PowerPoint output.
- Strict anti-improvisation rule: always follow the defined workflow and file structure.
